verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships 24 official SDKs spanning backend (Python), web (JS, React, Vue, script tag, Cloudflare edge) and mobile (Kotlin/Android, Swift/iOS, React Native, Flutter). Its docs state that all SDKs use the same assignment logic, backed by a 400+ language-agnostic JSON test suite, which supports consistent flag behavior across the stack. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of cross-SDK consistency, and feature parity gaps exist (e.g., streaming is JavaScript/React only).
